== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The old lead said "the 5th expansion of Star Wars CCG" and "CardGuide numbering: 5th product", while the next paragraph called it "the first expansion after Premiere". The lead now says first expansion after Premiere; "5th" looks like CardGuide product numbering (counting Premiere printings), not expansion order.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* "CardGuide numbering: 5th product." (catalog bookkeeping, no ref)
* Sources entries not cited by any sentence, removed with the Sources list:
** [https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions] at Decipher.com (archive, 4 May 1999)
** [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008)
** [https://www.starwarsccg.org/collecting/ SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia] at starwarsccg.org (web version of the cited Encyclopedia 3.2 PDF)
* The Decipher Light Side / Dark Side card lists and Complete Card List PDF are now refs on the card count in the lead.
